author: Karl Rock
description:
Imagine picking up a passenger in Karachi, Pakistan, only for her to start rolling weed in the back of your taxi!

This Pakistani taxi driver told me about a woman who started rolling drugs during her ride. When he asked her to stop, she simply told him to keep driving! He wasn't having it and ended up dropping her off before reaching her destination.

Would you have kicked her out too?
title: She Was Doing Drugs in My Taxi!
